title: Services Annex to the Travel Protection Plans
content:
Alongside the benefits it insures, each plan of the Travel Protection Plans carries a service entitlement:
the hours a day the emergency assistance line is staffed, whether a travel concierge and remote medical
consultation are included, and the rate at which traveller club points accrue on the premium paid.

| Plan | Assistance line (hours a day) | Travel concierge included | Remote medical consultation included | Club points earn rate on premium |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Basics Essential | 12 | No | No | 0% |
| Trip Basics Standard | 24 | No | Yes | 25% |
| TripGuard Plus | 24 | No | Yes | 50% |
| TripGuard Premier | 24 | Yes | Yes | 75% |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 24 | Yes | Yes | 100% |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 24 | No | Yes | 75% |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 24 | Yes | Yes | 100% |

## The entitlements put as sentences

The assistance line is staffed 24 hours a day on every plan but Trip Basics Essential, where it is staffed 12.
Remote medical consultation is included on every plan but Trip Basics Essential. A travel concierge is included
on TripGuard Premier, Cancel For Any Reason Elite and Annual Multi-Trip Executive alone. The club points earn
rate rises from 0% on Trip Basics Essential — a plan on which no points accrue at all — through 25% on Trip
Basics Standard and 50% on TripGuard Plus to 75% on TripGuard Premier and Annual Multi-Trip Traveller, and
reaches 100% on Cancel For Any Reason Elite and Annual Multi-Trip Executive.
